blocks.title: Chemical bond
blocks.text: Chemical bond woh force (quwwat) hai jo do ya zyada atoms, molecules ya ions ko aapas mein jor kar rakhti hai.

Kisi substance (madde) ki properties is baat par depend karti hain ke us ke atoms ke darmiyan kis qism ka chemical bond hai. Chemical bond mein ionic, covalent, dative aur metallic bonds aate hain, aur intermolecular forces (molecules ke darmiyan ki quwwatein) yani van der Waals forces bhi. Lekin van der Waals forces kaafi kamzor hoti hain, is liye unhen aam taur par pakka (pure) chemical bond nahi kaha jata. Is chapter mein hum pehle electronegativity ki madad se bonds ki qismein, bonding ki nau'iyat (nature), dipole moment aur polarity parhenge. Phir naye bonding theories, VSEPR, VBT, hybridization aur MOT, tafseel se aayenge. Us ke baad intermolecular forces, aur aakhir mein bond energies ki buniyad par chemical bonds aur intermolecular forces ka muqabla (comparison).
NaCl mein ionic bond hai aur woh solid (thos) hai, jabke pani covalent compound hai aur liquid (maya).

Bonding ka Lewis concept har qism ke bond ke banne ki aasan wazahat deta hai. Is theory ke mutabiq atoms is liye bond banate hain ke un ka sab se bahar wala shell poora ho jaye aur un ki configuration noble gas jaisi ban jaye. Aksar yeh valence shell mein octet (aath electrons) poora kar ke hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Lewis concept ek jumle mein batayein, aur chemical bond ki chaar qismein aur woh kamzor force batayein jo is chapter mein aati hai.
blocks.explanation: Atoms apna bahar wala shell poora karne ke liye, aksar octet tak, bond banate hain taake un ki configuration noble gas jaisi ho jaye. Bonds: ionic, covalent, dative aur metallic. Kamzor force: van der Waals (intermolecular) force.

items: Chemical bond atoms, molecules ya ions ko jorta hai; ionic, covalent, dative aur metallic asal bonds hain, van der Waals forces kamzor intermolecular forces hain.
Lewis concept: atoms apna bahar wala shell (octet) poora kar ke noble gas configuration pane ke liye bond banate hain.
